payload.tension: The passage states acts 2:1–21 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit fills and is poured out; the wording centers attention on “They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
